name: Limewired

evidence.note: Band site: high-energy 80s, 90s and 2000s covers; calls a show a traveling party for all ages.
Flanagan's Pub, Ronkonkoma: Oktoberfest Oct 4 in the back lot with Limewired from 2 PM.
Band calendar also lists 89 North and Daisy's Nashville Lounge shows.

dancing.notes: A party cover band that calls its shows a 'traveling party'. Its Oct 4 gig is a family-friendly outdoor Oktoberfest.

description: A Long Island cover band playing rock and pop hits from the 80s, 90s and 2000s at bars, breweries and outdoor festivals.
